title: Subsequence heterogeneity contrastive learning for time series anomaly detection
method_summary: 固定间隔和时间层次掩码生成异质子序列，以对比目标增强任意时序骨干的正常模式学习。
reproduction_gap: 作者VAE源码保留，五骨干Transformer/VAE/CNN/RNN/LSTM及THM/连续性/高斯KL/评分和部分消融已补；adaptive masking及精确架构仍待对齐。

configuration.score_contract: finite [B,T,C] preprocessed grouped windows -> [B,T] continuous scores; evaluator handles overlap/threshold/PA
configuration.benchmark_acceptance: not_run; CPU behavioral checks do not establish paper performance
assumptions: Official local release contains VAE branch only; this Transformer branch is independent paper reconstruction.
Point/pair each has its own encoder, shared between even/odd, following author VAE branch organization.
Transformer mean/logvariance are learned heads; paper does not specify how these statistics are obtained for deterministic Transformer.
Sinusoidal positions and heads=8 are explicit architecture choices; paper specifies width128 and layers3.
Random mask uses frozen seed1103 at train and test for repeatable ablation; exact paper random/adaptive algorithms unspecified.
Adaptive mask ablation remains unimplemented; VAE baseline uses preserved original author code separately.
Reconstruction alternative is paired branch channel-mean MSE; exact Recon ablation recipe absent.
CNN kernel3/depthwise+pointwise, RNN/LSTM hidden=128/layers3 are explicit unpublished architecture choices.
Independent VAE reconstruction follows per-time MLP hidden256 layout; deterministic mean-latent inference differs from published code stochastic sampling.
